evidence_chain: method principle explains why the auxiliary coefficient exists
loss definition and reduction establish the mathematical scale
Train-only loss and backbone-gradient audit checks whether the registered grid spans meaningful influence
a frozen Simulation Validation protocol selects the final value without Test or real-XRD access
multi-seed sensitivity evidence checks that the final result is not a lucky isolated point

hu_et_al_2026_sd3net.citation: Haotian Hu et al., Hyperspectral single-source domain generalization via structured data simulation and domain-disparity decorrelation, Knowledge-Based Systems 348 (2026) 116429
hu_et_al_2026_sd3net.source_domain: cross-scene hyperspectral image single-source domain generalization

table_5_record.sensitivity_design: fix lambda_3 as a scale anchor and jointly inspect lambda_1 and lambda_2 with a 3D surface

figure_12_record.interpretation: the paper separately calls this a regularization parameter but does not explicitly reconcile it with the lambda_3=1 loss weight reported in Equations 17 and Table 5

selection_context.checkpoint_rule: best validation model after validation accuracy converges

allowed_evidentiary_use: support the existence of a residual entropy/decorrelation mechanism
support controlling relative loss contributions rather than treating weights as physical constants
support sensitivity analysis and module ablation
prohibited_evidentiary_use: treat 1e-4 as the Hu et al. lambda_3 value
claim the paper numerically validates any V9-T lambda_res grid

lambda_js.necessity_basis: balances paired-view JS consistency against supervised classification
lambda_js.mathematical_scale: natural-log JS divergence is batch mean and lies in [0, ln(2)]
lambda_js.current_grid_basis: single human-approved pre-Validation revision from the epoch-5 Train-only learned-state gradient ratio; Dynamic ERM supplies the lambda=0 anchor, while [0.3, 3, 30] is a strict decade grid designed to cover weak, material non-dominant, and dominant influence
lambda_js.train_only_scale_result: the learned-state epoch-5 unweighted JS/classification backbone-gradient ratio motivated the human revision; direct Train-only autograd measurement gave median weighted ratios 0.02283, 0.22842, and 2.28533 for lambda 0.3, 3, and 30, covering weak, material non-dominant, and dominant influence without Validation performance
lambda_js.final_selection: three-point Simulation Validation search after the candidate range is frozen

lambda_res.necessity_basis: balances residual class-confusion KL against supervised classification
lambda_res.mathematical_scale: KL(q || Uniform) equals ln(7)-H(q), uses batch mean, and lies in [0, ln(7)]
lambda_res.current_grid_basis: single human-approved pre-Validation revision from the epoch-5 Train-only learned-state gradient ratio; Dynamic ERM supplies the lambda=0 anchor, while [0.2, 2, 20] is a strict decade grid designed to cover weak, material non-dominant, and dominant influence
lambda_res.external_method_basis: Hu et al. 2026 supports residual entropy/decorrelation, relative loss weighting, sensitivity analysis, and ablation as methodological precedents
lambda_res.external_numerical_limit: Hu et al. report lambda_3=1 in Equations 17/Table 5 while a separate Figure 12 regularization parameter lambda peaks near 1e-4 without an explicit mapping; neither value is transferable to the V9-T loss scale
lambda_res.train_only_scale_result: the disjoint Train residual probe demonstrated class signal and the learned-state epoch-5 unweighted Residual/classification backbone-gradient ratio motivated the human revision; direct Train-only autograd measurement gave median weighted ratios 0.02581, 0.25854, and 2.58715 for lambda 0.2, 2, and 20, covering weak, material non-dominant, and dominant influence without Validation performance
lambda_res.final_selection: three-point Simulation Validation search after the candidate range is frozen

warmup_epochs.basis: prevent the residual objective from influencing the initial classifier trajectory
warmup_epochs.selection_policy: fixed; exact schedule is unit-tested; no result-driven search

ramp_epochs.basis: smoothly introduce the residual objective after warm-up
ramp_epochs.selection_policy: fixed; exact schedule is unit-tested; no result-driven search

validation_tuning_authorization.authority: explicit user instruction in the active Codex task
validation_tuning_authorization.scope: exactly seven registered Validation-only development tuning runs on the measured laptop target
validation_tuning_authorization.machine: LENOVO 82WM with NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU

diagnostic_gradient_compensation_factors.interpretation: inverse median backbone-gradient ratios from an unlearned 128-step trajectory; diagnostic alarm signals only, not theoretical weights, grid proposals, selected values, or automatically registered values

one_revision_policy.required_before_revision: run a Train-only milestone audit after the backbone shows a non-random classification signal and require the residual probe to demonstrate class-prediction competence before interpreting residual confusion; review view strength and raw losses without Validation/Test access
one_revision_policy.required_after_revision: directly measure every revised candidate on a rebuilt Train-only learned state; update this file, the main contract, hashes, and documentation; freeze only if the candidate Gate passes
